lazy_worker_routing.details: da3_worker.py --action real_pipeline integrates with envs/teachers/t6/pipeline.py and verifies upstream source tree identity & weights; blocks forward pass with model_runs=0 when unapproved

mock_model_runs_zero.details: mock_run strictly outputs model_runs=0 and is_mock=True, preventing false claims of real model execution

no_synchronous_adapter_bypass.details: Removed synchronous adapter bypass in parent; all executions strictly launch child process group via Popen(start_new_session=True) with continuous parent supervision and POSIX empty group proof

hardware_resource_guards.details: Reused hardware guards: AC power required (battery rejected), system RAM reserve >= 16 GiB, swap growth <= 1 GiB, process group RSS <= 8 GiB

central_paths_and_double_checked_locking.details: Locked formal run store/lock paths to central paths; cumulative views and cumulative budget are checked outside lock and re-checked inside worker_lock

production_cli_pre_reservation_rejection.details: Production CLI rejects before RunStore reservation with exit 1 if real model execution is unapproved; zero budget consumed, zero fake success

physical_source_mutations.details: 4 physical mutated single-region files created in reports/V9-T30/r2/mutations/; 3-direction evidence captured

mutation_controls_3_directions.name: Control 1: Wall Clock Timeout Supervision Gate
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_1_clean_pass: Clean code + fast task (0.02s <= 1.0s) -> returncode=0, violation=None
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_2_clean_catch: Clean code + runaway task (3.0s > 0.2s) -> killed by supervisor, violation=timeout, empty_group_proven=True
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_3_mutated_proof: Mutated code (timeout guard disabled) + runaway task -> ignores timeout, violation=None, proves guard necessity

mutation_controls_3_directions.name: Control 2: Process Group RSS Protection Gate
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_1_clean_pass: Clean code + normal memory (5 MiB <= 150 MiB) -> returncode=0
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_2_clean_catch: Clean code + runaway memory (200 MiB > 80 MiB limit) -> killed by supervisor, violation=rss_limit, empty_group_proven=True
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_3_mutated_proof: Mutated code (RSS guard disabled) + runaway memory -> ignores RSS limit, violation=None, proves guard necessity

mutation_controls_3_directions.name: Control 3: Orphan Grandchild Leak Detection Gate
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_1_clean_pass: Clean code + clean child process -> returncode=0, empty_group_proven=True
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_2_clean_catch: Clean code + early exit with grandchild -> killed by supervisor, violation=grandchild_leak, empty_group_proven=True
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_3_mutated_proof: Mutated code (leak guard disabled) + early exit -> ignores leaked grandchild, violation=None, proves guard necessity

mutation_controls_3_directions.name: Control 4: Corrupt Ledger Fail-Closed Protection Gate
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_1_clean_pass: Clean code + valid DB -> accurately computes active_seconds and cumulative_views (15 views)
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_2_clean_catch: Clean code + corrupt DB -> fails closed raising BenchmarkRefusalError, strictly no fallback to 0.0
mutation_controls_3_directions.direction_3_mutated_proof: Mutated code (swallows error) + corrupt DB -> silently returns 0.0, 0, proves clean fail-closed necessity
